schema_source: automatically extracted from each SQLite database
metric_note: This is a local development-time row comparison, not official Spider Test Suite Accuracy. Official evaluation will be integrated separately.

results.question: what are all the addresses including line 1 and line 2?
results.generated_sql: SELECT line_1, line_2 FROM Addresses;
results.gold_sql: SELECT line_1 ,  line_2 FROM addresses

results.question: How many departments offer any degree?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT department_id) FROM Degree_Programs;
results.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT department_id) FROM Degree_Programs

results.question: Whose permanent address is different from his or her current address? List his or her first name.
results.generated_sql: SELECT s.first_name FROM Students s JOIN Addresses a1 ON s.current_address_id = a1.address_id JOIN Addresses a2 ON s.permanent_address_id = a2.address_id WHERE a1.address_id != a2.address_id;
results.gold_sql: SELECT first_name FROM Students WHERE current_address_id != permanent_address_id

results.question: List the section_name in reversed lexicographical order.
results.generated_sql: SELECT section_name FROM Sections ORDER BY section_name DESC;
results.gold_sql: SELECT section_name FROM Sections ORDER BY section_name DESC

results.question: How many degrees does the engineering department offer?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Degree_Programs WHERE department_id = (SELECT department_id FROM Departments WHERE department_name = 'Engineering');
results.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Departments AS T1 JOIN Degree_Programs AS T2 ON T1.department_id  =  T2.department_id WHERE T1.department_name  =  'engineer'

results.question: When is the first transcript released? List the date and details.
results.generated_sql: SELECT transcript_date, other_details FROM Transcripts ORDER BY transcript_date ASC LIMIT 1;
results.gold_sql: SELECT transcript_date ,  other_details FROM Transcripts ORDER BY transcript_date ASC LIMIT 1

results.question: How many times at most can a course enrollment result show in different transcripts? Also show the course enrollment id.
results.generated_sql: SELECT student_course_id, COUNT(*) AS max_transcript_count FROM Transcript_Contents GROUP BY student_course_id ORDER BY max_transcript_count DESC LIMIT 1;
results.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) ,  student_course_id FROM Transcript_Contents GROUP BY student_course_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Find the kind of program which most number of students are enrolled in?
results.generated_sql: SELECT dp.degree_summary_name, COUNT(se.student_enrolment_id) AS number_of_students FROM Degree_Programs dp JOIN Student_Enrolment se ON dp.degree_program_id = se.degree_program_id GROUP BY dp.degree_summary_name ORDER BY number_of_students DESC LIMIT 1;
results.gold_sql: SELECT T1.degree_summary_name FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id GROUP BY T1.degree_summary_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Show the date and id of the transcript with at least 2 course results.
results.generated_sql: SELECT t.transcript_id, t.transcript_date FROM Transcripts t JOIN Transcript_Contents tc ON t.transcript_id = tc.transcript_id GROUP BY t.transcript_id HAVING COUNT(tc.student_course_id) >= 2;
results.gold_sql: SELECT T2.transcript_date ,  T1.transcript_id FROM Transcript_Contents AS T1 JOIN Transcripts AS T2 ON T1.transcript_id  =  T2.transcript_id GROUP BY T1.transcript_id HAVING count(*)  >=  2

results.question: Find the semester when both Master students and Bachelor students got enrolled in.
results.generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT se.semester_id FROM Student_Enrolment se JOIN Degree_Programs dp ON se.degree_program_id = dp.degree_program_id WHERE dp.degree_summary_name LIKE '%Master%' INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT se.semester_id FROM Student_Enrolment se JOIN Degree_Programs dp ON se.degree_program_id = dp.degree_program_id WHERE dp.degree_summary_name LIKE '%Bachelor%'
results.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.semester_id FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id WHERE degree_summary_name  =  'Master' INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT T2.semester_id FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id WHERE degree_summary_name  =  'Bachelor'

results.question: What are the arriving date and the departing date of all the dogs?

results.gold_sql: SELECT date_arrived ,  date_departed FROM Dogs

results.question: Which owners live in the state whose name contains the substring 'North'? List his first name, last name and email.

results.gold_sql: SELECT first_name ,  last_name ,  email_address FROM Owners WHERE state LIKE '%North%'

results.question: How much does the most expensive charge type costs?
results.generated_sql: SELECT charge_type, MAX(charge_amount) FROM Charges GROUP BY charge_type ORDER BY MAX(charge_amount) DESC LIMIT 1;
results.gold_sql: SELECT max(charge_amount) FROM Charges

results.question: Which dogs have not cost their owner more than 1000 for treatment ? List the dog names .
results.generated_sql: SELECT d.name FROM Dogs d WHERE d.dog_id NOT IN (SELECT t.dog_id FROM Treatments t WHERE t.cost_of_treatment > 1000) OR d.dog_id NOT IN (SELECT t.dog_id FROM Treatments t);
results.gold_sql: select name from dogs where dog_id not in ( select dog_id from treatments group by dog_id having sum(cost_of_treatment)  >  1000 )

results.question: How many professionals did not operate any treatment on dogs?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Professionals p LEFT JOIN Treatments t ON p.professional_id = t.professional_id WHERE t.treatment_id IS NULL;
results.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Professionals WHERE professional_id NOT IN ( SELECT professional_id FROM Treatments )

results.question: List pairs of the owner's first name and the dogs's name.
results.generated_sql: SELECT Owners.first_name, Dogs.name FROM Owners JOIN Dogs ON Owners.owner_id = Dogs.owner_id;
results.gold_sql: SELECT T1.first_name ,  T2.name FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id

results.question: List the names of the dogs of the rarest breed and the treatment dates of them.
results.generated_sql: SELECT D.name, T.date_of_treatment FROM Dogs D JOIN Treatments T ON D.dog_id = T.dog_id WHERE D.breed_code = (SELECT breed_code FROM Breeds GROUP BY breed_code ORDER BY COUNT(*) LIMIT 1)
results.gold_sql: SELECT T1.name ,  T2.date_of_treatment FROM Dogs AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.dog_id  =  T2.dog_id WHERE T1.breed_code  =  ( SELECT breed_code FROM Dogs GROUP BY breed_code ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1 )

results.question: Which first names are used for professionals or owners but are not used as dog names?
results.generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT first_name FROM Owners UNION SELECT first_name FROM Professionals EXCEPT SELECT name FROM Dogs;
results.gold_sql: SELECT first_name FROM Professionals UNION SELECT first_name FROM Owners EXCEPT SELECT name FROM Dogs

results.question: What is the name of the breed with the most dogs?
results.generated_sql: SELECT b.breed_name FROM Breeds b JOIN Dogs d ON b.breed_code = d.breed_code GROUP BY b.breed_code ORDER BY COUNT(d.dog_id) DESC LIMIT 1;
results.gold_sql: SELECT T1.breed_name FROM Breeds AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.breed_code  =  T2.breed_code GROUP BY T1.breed_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Which owner has paid the largest amount of money in total for their dogs? Show the owner id and zip code.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT o.owner_id, o.zip_code
FROM Owners o
JOIN Dogs d ON o.owner_id = d.owner_id
JOIN (
    SELECT dog_id, SUM(cost_of_treatment) AS total_cost
    FROM Treatments
    GROUP BY dog_id
) t ON d.dog_id = t.dog_id
GROUP BY o.owner_id, o.zip_code
ORDER BY SUM(t.total_cost) DESC
LIMIT 1;
results.gold_sql: SELECT T1.owner_id ,  T1.zip_code FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id JOIN Treatments AS T3 ON T2.dog_id  =  T3.dog_id GROUP BY T1.owner_id ORDER BY sum(T3.cost_of_treatment) DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: How many continents are there?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM continents;
results.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM CONTINENTS;

results.question: What is the average horsepower of the cars before 1980?
results.generated_sql: SELECT AVG(CAST(Horsepower AS REAL)) FROM cars_data WHERE Year < 1980;
results.gold_sql: SELECT avg(horsepower) FROM CARS_DATA WHERE YEAR  <  1980;

results.question: What is the smallest weight of the car produced with 8 cylinders on 1974 ?
results.generated_sql: SELECT MIN(Weight) FROM cars_data WHERE Cylinders = 8 AND Year = 1974;
results.gold_sql: select min(weight) from cars_data where cylinders  =  8 and year  =  1974

results.question: What is the average edispl of the cars of model volvo?
results.generated_sql: SELECT AVG(c.Edispl) FROM cars_data c JOIN car_names cn ON c.Id = cn.MakeId WHERE cn.Model = 'volvo';
results.gold_sql: SELECT avg(T2.edispl) FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN CARS_DATA AS T2 ON T1.MakeId  =  T2.Id WHERE T1.Model  =  'volvo';

results.question: Find the make and production time of the cars that were produced in the earliest year?
results.generated_sql: SELECT car_names.Make, cars_data.Year FROM cars_data JOIN car_names ON cars_data.Id = car_names.MakeId ORDER BY cars_data.Year ASC LIMIT 1;
results.gold_sql: SELECT T2.Make ,  T1.Year FROM CARS_DATA AS T1 JOIN CAR_NAMES AS T2 ON T1.Id  =  T2.MakeId WHERE T1.Year  =  (SELECT min(YEAR) FROM CARS_DATA);

results.question: How many car models are produced by each maker ? Only list the count and the maker full name .
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count, FullName FROM car_makers GROUP BY FullName;
results.gold_sql: select count(*) ,  t2.fullname from model_list as t1 join car_makers as t2 on t1.maker  =  t2.id group by t2.id;

results.question: Which model has the most version(make) of cars?
results.generated_sql: SELECT Model, COUNT(*) as version_count FROM car_names GROUP BY Model ORDER BY version_count DESC LIMIT 1;
results.gold_sql: SELECT Model FROM CAR_NAMES GROUP BY Model ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

results.question: How many car makers are there in each continents? List the continent name and the count.
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.Continent, COUNT(cm.Id) AS count FROM car_makers cm JOIN countries co ON cm.Country = co.CountryId JOIN continents c ON co.Continent = c.ContId GROUP BY c.Continent;
results.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Continent ,  count(*) FROM CONTINENTS AS T1 JOIN COUNTRIES AS T2 ON T1.ContId  =  T2.continent JOIN car_makers AS T3 ON T2.CountryId  =  T3.Country GROUP BY T1.Continent;

results.question: What are the name of the countries where there is not a single car maker?
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.CountryName FROM countries c LEFT JOIN car_makers cm ON c.Country = cm.Country WHERE cm.Country IS NULL;
results.gold_sql: SELECT CountryName FROM countries EXCEPT SELECT T1.CountryName FROM countries AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.countryId  =  T2.Country;

results.question: What are the id and names of the countries which have more than 3 car makers or produce the 'fiat' model?
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.CountryId, c.CountryName FROM countries c JOIN car_makers cm ON c.Country = cm.Country GROUP BY c.CountryId, c.CountryName HAVING COUNT(cm.Id) > 3 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM car_names cn JOIN model_list ml ON cn.Model = ml.Model WHERE ml.Maker IN (SELECT Id FROM car_makers WHERE Country = c.Country) AND cn.Model = 'fiat');
results.gold_sql: SELECT T1.countryId ,  T1.CountryName FROM Countries AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.CountryId  =  T2.Country GROUP BY T1.countryId HAVING count(*)  >  3 UNION SELECT T1.countryId ,  T1.CountryName FROM Countries AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.CountryId  =  T2.Country JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T3 ON T2.Id  =  T3.Maker WHERE T3.Model  =  'fiat';
